province.label: Province
province.help: Drives vehicle taxes, licensing presets, energy prices, and EV rebates.

targetEconomicMonthly.label: Target economic cost / month
targetEconomicMonthly.help: Goal for net horizon ownership cost divided by your ownership horizon.

ownershipHorizonMonths.label: Ownership horizon
ownershipHorizonMonths.help: How long you plan to keep the vehicle before selling or trading.

marketValue.label: Current market value
marketValue.help: Estimated value of your current car today.

vehicleAgeYears.label: Vehicle age
vehicleAgeYears.help: Age today in years. Used cars already took the steep early drop — older cars retain more of today's price over the same ownership horizon.

retainedValuePercent.label: Retained value at horizon
retainedValuePercent.help: Percent of purchase/market value retained at the ownership horizon. Auto follows an age-aware curve; override if you prefer.

targetAllInMonthly.label: Target all-in monthly
targetAllInMonthly.help: Legacy field — migrated to target economic cost.

balance.label: Remaining loan balance
balance.help: Payoff amount on your current car.

payment.label: Current payment
payment.help: Payment amount at the frequency you select.

tradeInValue.label: Trade-in / sale value
tradeInValue.help: Value of your current car. If you trade it in at a dealer it reduces the taxable base (BC: rate still from full price); a private sale is cash only, with no tax credit.

downPayment.label: Down payment
downPayment.help: Cash at signing (separate from positive trade equity).

apr.label: Financing APR
apr.help: Nominal annual rate. Auto loans compound monthly.

termMonths.label: Term
termMonths.help: Loan term in months. Typical range 48–84.
